readme.html:
Agent Skills

Open-source Agent Skills by David Ondrej, for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and any agent that loads SKILL.md files.

Run them on cloud agents with Cloudroom, free and open source.

Install

Requires Node.js. Run from your project, or add -g to install globally:

npx skills add davidondrej/skills                       # pick from all skills
npx skills add davidondrej/skills --skill deepapi -a claude-code

Or copy any skills/<name>/ folder into your agent's skills directory.

Layout

skills/<name>/SKILL.md     instructions, with name + description frontmatter
skills/<name>/references/  optional docs the agent loads on demand
skills/<name>/scripts/     optional helper scripts
AGENTS.md                  David's global agent instructions

Skills

  • 4x4 — Pull 16 fast decisions out of the user with 4 sets of 4 open questions, then present an implementation plan.
  • adr-verbatim — Record concise ADRs that preserve the user's decisions without conversational noise.
  • anti-sleep — Keep a Mac awake for a set duration or while a process runs.
  • ask-then-build — Clarify a feature, change, or refactor through questions, then write a build prompt for another agent.
  • bb-cli — Use this when controlling bb.
  • bb-plugins — Build, install, and debug bb plugins.
  • before-building — Fire the moment the user proposes a build.
  • better-prompt — Rewrite a prompt into a deeper version of the same task, the way a top professional would approach it.
  • boat — Manage Boat (boat.dev, formerly Box by Ascii) cloud sandboxes via API, CLI, and SSH.
  • browser-harness — Direct browser control via CDP.
  • browser-use — Direct browser control via CDP for web interaction: automation, scraping, testing, screenshots, and site/app work.
  • cmux — Control the cmux macOS terminal app: workspaces, panes, surfaces, browsers, notifications, settings, and hooks.
  • codex-subagent — Launch OpenAI Codex CLI as a subagent (ChatGPT subscription auth, no API key).
  • cua-driver — Use Cua Driver for desktop or browser tasks that are awkward or unavailable through Bash/APIs, or when the user explicitly wants GUI interaction: app testing, visual bug reproduction, form filling, calendar entry, screenshots, and demo recording.
  • decisions — Ask the agent to list all choices it made during the current work that it is not confident of.
  • deep-research — Run deep research through DeepAPI and save a report with sources.
  • deep-scrape — Build sourced JSON dossiers on people, companies, or topics with DeepAPI.
  • deepapi — Use DeepAPI for all web search, deep research, and web scraping (websites, LinkedIn, GitHub, X/Twitter, YouTube, Instagram) instead of built-in search, research, fetch, or browser tools.
  • designs — Show 4 better, new design options as separate real image renders of the actual app UI.
  • domain-checker — Check domain registration in batches using public RDAP APIs, without keys or login.
  • effective-agent-skills — Write, review, and debug agent skills.
  • fable-review — Launch an independent Fable code review and return it verbatim.
  • fable-safe-prompt — Make minimal prompt edits to reduce false-positive refusals from Fable.
  • file-tree — Manually-invoked skill that prints a nice file tree of the current topic in a code block.
  • fireflies-transcript — Fetch raw Fireflies.ai meeting transcripts.
  • gemini-review — Launch an independent Gemini 4 Carbon code review through Cursor at High reasoning and return it verbatim.
  • git-worktree — Use Git worktrees to isolate parallel coding tasks.
  • github-outside-sandbox — Run Git and GitHub CLI commands on the host when sandboxing blocks Keychain auth, network access, or .git writes.
  • global-agent-guardrails — Configure the shared guard against catastrophic shell commands in local AI agents.
  • goal-loop — Draft /goal prompts and explain persistent agent loops.
  • gpt-review — Launch an independent GPT-6-Astra code review and return it verbatim.
  • handoff — Capture session context for a fresh agent.
  • herdr — Operate and coordinate AI agents in Herdr workspaces in Ghostty.
  • image-prompt — Write four distinct prompts for AI image models.
  • keep-track — Keep track of open topics and decisions.
  • kimi-review — Launch an independent Kimi K3.1 Pro Max code review and return it verbatim, falling back across harnesses and routes until one works.
  • larp-detector — Skeptical review of outside contributions to public repos.
  • muse-review — Launch an independent Meta Muse Wonder Max code review through Pi and OpenRouter, and return it verbatim.
  • nagent — Launch a new bb worker thread with the right project, model, worktree, and task brief.
  • occams-razor — Stop overthinking and answer with what we actually know for sure, how you know, and a confidence %.
  • openrouter — Design, build, debug, and optimize OpenRouter API integrations.
  • persistent-localhost — Manage persistent dev servers, APIs, and other local processes on a port using macOS LaunchAgents.
  • prompt-for-others — Write a prompt teammates can give their AI agents to apply a fix, upgrade, or setup change.
  • read-all-adrs — Read every ADR markdown file in the project's docs/adr/ folder so you have full context on past decisions.
  • remind — Rewrite the last response simpler and shorter in plain English, prefixed with a 3-5 sentence TLDR of the conversation so far.
  • rename — Manually-invoked skill that renames the current thread or session to 2-5 lowercase descriptive words.
  • rename-process — Coordinate project or repository renames and moves involving Git, BB, services, or multiple machines.
  • repo-sync — Manage automatic Git syncing on macOS with repo-sync.
  • risky-changes — Verify assumptions before implementing large or risky changes to APIs, provider data, billing, pricing, quotas, or defaults.
  • self-archive — Archive the current Cloudroom thread and release its runtime.
  • setup-help — Guide setup one step at a time and show what remains.
  • state — Manually-invoked skill that recaps what the current thread is doing and how far along it is.
  • stop-overthinking — Manually-invoked skill that stops overthinking and forces a short, practical decision.
  • total-review — Run five independent max-effort reviews (Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Muse Wonder), merge their findings, and fix only what the user approves.
  • varied-search — Research a topic across the web, GitHub, and X/Twitter with DeepAPI and produce a concise Markdown report.

Contributing

This repo is generated from a private source repo and overwritten on every publish, so pull requests can't be merged.

License

MIT

skills.name: 4x4
skills.description: Pull 16 fast decisions out of the user with 4 sets of 4 open questions, then present an implementation plan. Only for risky changes, large product decisions, or large refactors. Run when the user types /4x4. Agents may suggest it in one line but never start it on their own.

skills.name: adr-verbatim
skills.description: Record concise ADRs that preserve the user''s decisions without conversational noise. Use for "adr-verbatim", "new ADR", "document that as an ADR", "record this decision", or supplied ADR wording.

skills.name: anti-sleep
skills.description: Keep a Mac awake for a set duration or while a process runs. Use only when the user explicitly invokes /anti-sleep.

skills.name: ask-then-build
skills.description: Clarify a feature, change, or refactor through questions, then write a build prompt for another agent. Use for /ask-then-build or requests to ask questions before producing an implementation prompt.

skills.name: bb-cli
skills.description: Use this when controlling bb. The bb CLI inspects and manages threads, environments, projects, machines, providers, skills, plugins, settings, terminals, and other BB services.

skills.name: bb-plugins
skills.description: Build, install, and debug bb plugins. Use when the user wants a bb plugin, a sidebar panel, a bb CLI subcommand, an agent tool, a theme, a provider, or to extend bb itself. For running threads and the core bb CLI, use bb-cli instead.

skills.name: before-building
skills.description: Fire the moment the user proposes a build. Instantly surface the 1-3 consequential choices hidden in their idea. Can also be invoked with /before-building.

skills.name: better-prompt
skills.description: Rewrite a prompt into a deeper version of the same task, the way a top professional would approach it. Use only when explicitly invoked with /better-prompt.

skills.name: boat
skills.description: Manage Boat (boat.dev, formerly Box by Ascii) cloud sandboxes via API, CLI, and SSH. Use for provisioning, environments, secrets, templates, snapshots, stop/resume/fork, or running BB and coding agents on Boat.

skills.name: browser-harness
skills.description: Direct browser control via CDP. Use when the user wants to automate, scrape, test, or interact with web pages. Connects to the user's already-running Chrome.

skills.name: browser-use
skills.description: Direct browser control via CDP for web interaction: automation, scraping, testing, screenshots, and site/app work.

skills.name: cmux
skills.description: Control the cmux macOS terminal app: workspaces, panes, surfaces, browsers, notifications, settings, and hooks. Use only when the user explicitly names cmux. Read before running any cmux command.

skills.name: codex-subagent
skills.description: Launch OpenAI Codex CLI as a subagent (ChatGPT subscription auth, no API key). Use when delegating a self-contained coding task to Codex from another agent — parallel implementation work, a second opinion, or an independent verification pass.

skills.name: cua-driver
skills.description: Use Cua Driver for desktop or browser tasks that are awkward or unavailable through Bash/APIs, or when the user explicitly wants GUI interaction: app testing, visual bug reproduction, form filling, calendar entry, screenshots, and demo recording. Also covers Cua setup; not OpenAI Codex Computer Use

skills.name: decisions
skills.description: Ask the agent to list all choices it made during the current work that it is not confident of. Manual-only; the user must ask for it by name.

skills.name: deep-research
skills.description: Run deep research through DeepAPI and save a report with sources. Use when asked for deep research, DeepAPI research, or Perplexity deep research.

skills.name: deep-scrape
skills.description: Build sourced JSON dossiers on people, companies, or topics with DeepAPI. Use for profiles, prospects, vendor due diligence, or customer research across sources; use deep-research for recommendations.

skills.name: deepapi
skills.description: Use DeepAPI for all web search, deep research, and web scraping (websites, LinkedIn, GitHub, X/Twitter, YouTube, Instagram) instead of built-in search, research, fetch, or browser tools. Prefer dedicated platform endpoints over web search. Instagram has profile, post, comment, and hashtag endpoints;

skills.name: designs
skills.description: Show 4 better, new design options as separate real image renders of the actual app UI. Use for "designs" or when the user asks for new design ideas.

skills.name: domain-checker
skills.description: Check domain registration in batches using public RDAP APIs, without keys or login. Use only when the user explicitly invokes /domain-checker.

skills.name: effective-agent-skills
skills.description: Write, review, and debug agent skills. Use when creating or editing SKILL.md files, improving skill structure, or diagnosing invocation and execution problems.

skills.name: fable-review
skills.description: Launch an independent Fable code review and return it verbatim. Use for /fable-review, or when the user or another agent asks for a Fable review.

skills.name: fable-safe-prompt
skills.description: Make minimal prompt edits to reduce false-positive refusals from Fable. Use only when the user explicitly invokes /fable-safe-prompt.

skills.name: file-tree
skills.description: Manually-invoked skill that prints a nice file tree of the current topic in a code block. Use when the user says "file-tree" or "file tree".

skills.name: fireflies-transcript
skills.description: Fetch raw Fireflies.ai meeting transcripts. Use only when the user explicitly invokes /fireflies-transcript; for YouTube, use youtube-transcript.

skills.name: gemini-review
skills.description: Launch an independent Gemini 4 Carbon code review through Cursor at High reasoning and return it verbatim. Use for /gemini-review, or when the user or another agent asks for a Gemini review.

skills.name: git-worktree
skills.description: Use Git worktrees to isolate parallel coding tasks. Use when setting up a task checkout, working in a shared repo, or managing existing worktrees.

skills.name: github-outside-sandbox
skills.description: Run Git and GitHub CLI commands on the host when sandboxing blocks Keychain auth, network access, or .git writes. Use for gh auth, repo/PR operations, index.lock, or permission errors; covers execution context only.

skills.name: global-agent-guardrails
skills.description: Configure the shared guard against catastrophic shell commands in local AI agents. Use when changing block patterns, adding an agent or machine, or investigating why a command was or wasn't blocked.

skills.name: goal-loop
skills.description: Draft /goal prompts and explain persistent agent loops. Use for goal or Ralph loops, autonomous run setup, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

skills.name: gpt-review
skills.description: Launch an independent GPT-6-Astra code review and return it verbatim. Use for /gpt-review, or when the user or another agent asks for a GPT review.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Capture session context for a fresh agent. Use for handoffs, context limits, switching focus, ending sessions, or splitting work across sessions.

skills.name: herdr
skills.description: Operate and coordinate AI agents in Herdr workspaces in Ghostty. Use when the user mentions Herdr or asks to inspect, message, wait for, or coordinate its agents. Excludes cmux and ordinary terminal sessions.

skills.name: image-prompt
skills.description: Write four distinct prompts for AI image models. Use for image, thumbnail, banner, logo, or illustration prompts. Produces prompt text only.

skills.name: keep-track
skills.description: Keep track of open topics and decisions. Use when the user says "keep-track" or asks to keep a running list of remaining items.

skills.name: kimi-review
skills.description: Launch an independent Kimi K3.1 Pro Max code review and return it verbatim, falling back across harnesses and routes until one works. Use for /kimi-review, or when the user or another agent asks for a Kimi review.

skills.name: larp-detector
skills.description: Skeptical review of outside contributions to public repos. Use when reviewing, ranking, or replying to public GitHub pull requests or issues from outside contributors, or when the user says "larp-detector".

skills.name: muse-review
skills.description: Launch an independent Meta Muse Wonder Max code review through Pi and OpenRouter, and return it verbatim. Use for /muse-review, or when the user or another agent asks for a Muse review.

skills.name: nagent
skills.description: Launch a new bb worker thread with the right project, model, worktree, and task brief. Use for nagent, launching a bb session, or a standalone bb agent. Covers thread creation; use bb-cli for managing existing threads.

skills.name: occams-razor
skills.description: Stop overthinking and answer with what we actually know for sure, how you know, and a confidence %. Use for "occams-razor", or when the user asks what we actually know, whether something is really true, or tells you to stop overthinking.

skills.name: openrouter
skills.description: Design, build, debug, and optimize OpenRouter API integrations. Use for any OpenRouter API work, including models, reasoning, routing, media, tools, structured output, cost, or performance.

skills.name: persistent-localhost
skills.description: Manage persistent dev servers, APIs, and other local processes on a port using macOS LaunchAgents. Use when starting, stopping, restarting, inspecting, or troubleshooting local servers that should survive shell exit and restart after crashes.

skills.name: prompt-for-others
skills.description: Write a prompt teammates can give their AI agents to apply a fix, upgrade, or setup change. Use only when the user explicitly invokes /prompt-for-others.

skills.name: read-all-adrs
skills.description: Read every ADR markdown file in the project's docs/adr/ folder so you have full context on past decisions. Use only when the user explicitly calls it.

skills.name: remind
skills.description: Rewrite the last response simpler and shorter in plain English, prefixed with a 3-5 sentence TLDR of the conversation so far. Manual-only, invoked as /remind.

skills.name: rename-process
skills.description: Coordinate project or repository renames and moves involving Git, BB, services, or multiple machines. Preserve work and history while updating operational paths. Excludes ordinary file, code-symbol, and thread-title renames.

skills.name: rename
skills.description: Manually-invoked skill that renames the current thread or session to 2-5 lowercase descriptive words. Use when the user says "rename", "rename this", "rename thread", or "rename session".

skills.name: repo-sync
skills.description: Manage automatic Git syncing on macOS with repo-sync. Use only when the user explicitly invokes /repo-sync.

install.skillsAdd: npx skills add davidondrej/skills                       # pick from all skills
